enemy_class_notes: Static map markers describe encounter loci, not a guaranteed spawned enemy tier.
Elite is a runtime stronger variant with additional affixes; no static E marker is emitted.
Operatives are co-op-only runtime enemies and therefore have no static map marker.
Mutation Agent is labeled A only for an exact authored actor; campaign horde anchors do not imply one.
Captain boss pits occur outside X-4; X-4 boss pits contain Destructors.

enemies.name: Stealth Slayer
descriptions: Appears from stealth beside heroes, then fights in melee.
enemies.behavior: It spawns stealthed, reveals on its first accepted attack or hit, and pursues into close melee.

enemies.name: Draining Simian
descriptions: Can drain health over time if it gets close enough to its target.
Becomes exhausted for a short time after stealing a significant amount of health.
enemies.behavior: Its close-range eight-tick channel heals from committed damage, then its authored channel lifecycle releases before the next attack.

enemies.name: Vampiric Leaper
descriptions: Hopping area effect attack
enemies.behavior: Its authored leap lands with a four-unit area attack against every admitted hero and targetable companion.

enemies.name: Carrion Shambler
descriptions: Can consume the corpses of its allies to become larger and stronger.
Uses its large fists to smash heroes in melee range.
enemies.behavior: It claims and consumes eligible allied corpses, gaining stacked damage and body scale, and otherwise uses its multi-target frontal melee.

enemies.name: Necrotic Leech
descriptions: Fires long range necro projectiles.
Will regain health when nearby allies are damaged.
enemies.behavior: It uses the ranked long-range supernatural projectile and its nearby-allied-damage listener heals it from committed damage.

enemies.name: Animus
descriptions: Resurrects nearby allies who have recently been killed.
In between resurrections, flees and throws ghostly projectiles.
enemies.behavior: It revives the nearest eligible encounter corpse at 40 percent health; without one, it backs away from a close hero and fires the ranked GhostlyBolt projectile before checking for another corpse. The flee pursuit is an explicit secondary phase, so the primary resurrection-family guard no longer releases it as incompatible.

enemies.name: Blasting Fiend
descriptions: Fires slow ranged projectiles and strafes sideways between attacks.
enemies.behavior: Ranked Poison Spit alternates with one bounded navigation-clipped lateral strafe or a short idle before the next attack.

enemies.name: Tentacler
descriptions: Causes spiky thorns to emerge from underneath a hero..
Damage can be avoided by staying mobile.
enemies.behavior: It snapshots the hero’s position, warns there after one second, and damages only actors still inside the strict two-unit radius at 2.5 seconds.

enemies.name: Caustic Stinger
descriptions: Circles its target and periodically darts in for a fast sting.
enemies.behavior: Navigation-clipped circle movement alternates with the recovered Darting Attack.

enemies.name: Menace Weed
descriptions: Roots to channel healing near allies; otherwise fires rapid thorns.
enemies.behavior: The ally-dependent phase selects its repeated six-unit heal aura or its ranked multishot Thorn Dart.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals badly hurt allies; roots heroes, calls nearby friends to attack them, and keeps away from heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its strict-below-half support branch heals first, its repeated close-range retreat keeps separation, and Entangle applies the ranked root and redirects all living allies inside 20 units to that victim.

enemies.name: Reparatron
descriptions: Repairs nearby fallen robots, bringing them back to life if given enough time.
Can use its repair tools as melee weapons if given the opportunity.
enemies.behavior: It resurrects an eligible nearby robot through the repair channel and otherwise attacks with Arc Welding melee.

enemies.name: Acid Shell
descriptions: Spits acid at the heroes while strafing between attacks.
Highly resistant to energy damage while mobile.
At half health, withdraws into its shell, becoming immune to physical damage and emitting area effect poison.
enemies.behavior: Its acid projectile, rank-shaped Energy Defense, bounded post-shot strafe-or-idle movement, half-health Physical-immunity Turtle phase, and ranked poison pulses are active.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Has an orbiting drone that will shoot lasers at heroes.
At half health, will become invulnerable for a limited time.
enemies.behavior: One untargetable owner-bound NomadDrone uses the exact baseline SentryDroneLaser against the captain's current target and is deleted with its owner; the captain retains its strict-below-half ranked shield.

enemies.name: Pouncing Stalker
descriptions: Can close distance quickly with his leap attack.
Will resurrect if killed at the wrong time.
enemies.behavior: It chooses the authored leap outside Swipe range and its persistent self-resurrection sign now consumes the first lethal hit, restores it at 40 percent health, and resumes combat once.

enemies.name: Hypno Mantis
descriptions: Lobs a small sleeping cloud, then closes on sleeping heroes for a melee swipe.
enemies.behavior: Sleep Mushroom creates the three-tick radius-two cloud and close targets switch to Rez Melee.
